documents.title: Requirements
documents.text: Functional requirements specify services and observable system behavior. Nonfunctional requirements constrain quality, including performance and security. 非功能需求规定性能和安全等质量约束。

documents.title: Use cases
documents.text: A use case describes interaction between an actor and a system to reach a goal. 用例描述参与者与系统之间为达成目标而发生的交互。

documents.title: Cohesion
documents.text: High cohesion keeps closely related responsibilities within one module. 高内聚将密切相关的职责放在同一个模块中。

documents.title: Coupling
documents.text: Low coupling reduces dependencies between modules and limits the propagation of changes.

documents.title: Unit testing
documents.text: Unit testing verifies small components in isolation, using controlled substitutes for external dependencies.

documents.title: Integration testing
documents.text: Integration testing checks interactions between assembled components and detects interface mismatches.

documents.title: Black box testing
documents.text: Black box testing derives test cases from specified inputs and outputs without inspecting source code.

documents.title: White box testing
documents.text: White box testing uses program control flow and branch coverage to design test cases.

documents.title: Waterfall development
documents.text: Waterfall development organizes work into sequential phases with explicit handoffs between phases.

documents.title: Agile development
documents.text: Agile development uses short iterations and frequent customer feedback to adapt plans.

documents.title: Risk management
documents.text: Risk management identifies uncertain events, estimates likelihood and impact, and plans mitigation.

documents.title: Software maintenance
documents.text: Software maintenance includes corrective, adaptive, perfective, and preventive changes after delivery.
